title: Fix Compose Bundle Install Dropping Custom Kit Name
description: Rust test `tests::sidecar_install_create_accepts_full_kit_store_bundle_doc` in compose/client/bin/store/rs/bin.rs fails: after POSTing a full DevBackboneBundleDoc bundle (with wip.initialKit.name = "BundleInstallName") to /install, querying theKit.kit.name returns the hardcoded default "the kit" instead of the custom name. Root cause under investigation in compose/client/lib/rs/lib.rs spawn_from_install_json_value / DevBackboneBundleDoc::hydrate_into_graph and Graph::materialized_kit_for_workspace, which appears to replay a stale Graph::the_kit_snapshot_store envelope (seeded once at Graph::new() with the default kit) over the freshly-hydrated kit, clobbering the custom name. Fix must land in the shared compose crate, not the test.
